The Treatment

What Are
Polynucleotides?

Polynucleotides (PNCT) are a next-generation injectable treatment derived from purified, bio-compatible DNA fragments. Unlike fillers that add volume, polynucleotides work by stimulating the skin's own repair and regeneration process.

Once injected, they activate fibroblasts — the cells responsible for collagen and elastin production — and promote deep hydration by attracting and retaining water molecules within the skin structure.

The result is genuinely healthier skin: firmer, more hydrated, with improved texture and reduced laxity. Results build gradually over 4–8 weeks and continue improving with subsequent sessions.

Ideal Candidates

Who Is It
Right For?

Polynucleotides are ideal for clients focused on improving skin quality rather than just adding volume or relaxing muscles.

Those with dull, tired or dehydrated skin that lacks quality and glow

Clients noticing early to moderate skin laxity and fine lines

Anyone wanting to improve skin health rather than just appearance

Clients with dark circles or hollowness under the eyes

Those looking for a natural, regenerative alternative to filler

People wanting to maintain and extend the results of other treatments

The Process

How It Works

A precise, personalised procedure delivered at our Winslow clinic.

1

Consultation

Nafisa assesses your skin quality, concerns and goals — determining whether polynucleotides alone or in combination with other treatments will give the best outcome.

2

Preparation

A topical anaesthetic is applied before treatment for comfort. The skin is cleansed thoroughly.

3

Injection

The polynucleotide solution is injected using a fine needle into the targeted areas. Treatment typically takes 30–45 minutes.

4

Initial Healing

Some mild redness or small papules (bumps) at injection sites are normal and resolve within 24–48 hours.

5

Results Build Over Time

Improvement is gradual — most clients notice a meaningful difference at 4–6 weeks. A course of 2–3 sessions spaced 4 weeks apart is recommended.
